about_the_game:
Intro

In a future that seems perfectly optimized,

there’s no need to worry about food, housing, or employment.

The company provides everything — and expects everything in return.Work has been gamified: complete tasks, earn points, unlock titles.

Life is orderly, uneventful, and quietly consuming.

Until one day, a strange popup interrupts the routine:

 

"Are you truly happy?"

About the Demo

This demo includes content from the prologue through the end of Chapter 1,
with approximately 15–20 minutes of gameplay and 3 possible Bad Endings.

It also features a demo-exclusive Maze of Debate, a special sequence that does not appear in the full version.
Get an early taste of the game’s unique blend of logic puzzles and narrative interaction.

Demo Highlights

  • Full content from the Prologue and Chapter 1

  • 3 branching Bad Endings based on your choices

  • Exploration gameplay featuring map investigation, light stealth, and deduction

  • A demo-exclusive Maze of Debate not available in the full release

If you enjoy the demo, please consider adding the game to your wishlist—it really helps!

name: Work Life Balance Demo
short_description: “Are you truly happy?” — A dystopian RPG of corporate satire. In a future where work defines life, 【Work Life Balance】 may be the key to happiness—or a crafted illusion. Join the mysterious Fellowship and uncover the truth. Demo includes the beginning chapters.
